name: web-search
description: Keyless multi-engine web search, clean-Markdown fetch, and paginated read for AI agents, plus arxiv and github lookup. Bundles two portable SKILLs (clearnet and Tor), a websearch CLI with a one-call init, a self-hosted SearXNG that needs no Docker, an optional egress proxy (NordVPN SOCKS5), an optional Tor layer for .onion search and fetch, and a doctor that self-tests every engine. Needs internet; no API keys.
